entries.descriptionOriginal: awp_dust_ramps is a competitive 5v5 bomb defusal map with a single bombsite, built for aim practice. Two bases face each other across a Dust-style arena. In the middle, a hanging bridge held up only by ramps carries the bombsite and the map's AWPs: whoever climbs first grabs one, but stands exposed to the whole enemy team. Side tunnels with sliding metal doors give you a way to flank and rotate. How it plays No buying: M4s, AK-47s and Desert Eagles are on the ground at each spawn. Keep whatever you pick up if you survive the round. One AWP on each ramp of the bridge, plus helmet and kevlar up there only. Bomb can only be planted on the flat center of the bridge, between the cover. Hide deep inside a tunnel to survive the explosion; stay near the doors and you won't. Short 2-second freeze time: straight into the action. Credits Map by Renato Puente — www.renatopuente.com · www.eloctagono.online Inspired by an old CS 1.6 map I used to play at the internet cafes back in 2002.
